title: Characterizations of Hardy spaces on tube domains over polyhedral cones
summary: This paper is devoted to the equivalence of various characterizations of holomorphic $H^1$ Hardy spaces on tube domains over polyhedral cones. We establish a new iterated Poisson integral formula which reproduces holomorphic functions on such domains. However, this formula shows that holomorphic $H^1$ functions have boundary values in a new type of Hardy space of real variables on their Shilov boundaries $\mathbb{R}^n$, which cannot be treated by standard classical multi-parameter harmonic analysis.
